events.address: 726 Saint Peter Street, New Orleans, LA 70116
events.description: Traditional New Orleans jazz led by trumpeter Gregg Stafford at the historic Preservation Hall.
events.evidenceNote: Official artist/event page confirms this program. Calendar lists performances on Nov 15 and Nov 22 including evening shows. No fabricated year/time or ticket availability is assigned to the recurring program.

events.title: Live Jazz at Skull’s Rainbow Room
events.dateText: Nightly: solo piano from 5:15 PM, full band from 7:30 PM; check weekly lineup.
events.description: A nightly live-jazz program in Nashville’s historic Printers Alley. Performers vary by weekday.
events.evidenceNote: Official Jazz page gives nightly 5:15 PM and 7:30 PM performances and day-by-day lineup. Separate late-night burlesque cover charges must not be presented as jazz ticket prices.
events.imageCaption: Official jazz program photograph from Skull’s Rainbow Room.

events.title: King’s Palace Tour
events.dateText: Walk-up tickets only; offered when staffing permits. Ask the visitor-center front desk.
events.venue: Carlsbad Caverns National Park — Underground Rest Area
events.description: A 1.5-hour ranger-guided visit to four decorated chambers in Carlsbad Caverns. An additional park entrance ticket is required.
events.evidenceNote: NPS page updated Oct 5, 2026: walk-up only, staffing-dependent, no fixed tour day/time. $10/$5 tour fees exclude mandatory entrance, so priceKnown remains false for the full visit.
events.priceText: Tour: $10 adults / $5 eligible children and pass holders, plus park entrance fee.
events.imageCaption: Visitors in the Queen’s Chamber. NPS / Eymard Bangcoro.

events.title: Guided Congaree National Park Canoe Tour
events.dateText: Year-round, seven days a week; reservations required and subject to availability.
events.address: 1716 South Cedar Creek Road, Gadsden, SC 29052
events.description: A guided canoe outing through Congaree National Park’s Cedar Creek. The operator describes the trip as about three hours and four miles.
events.evidenceNote: Actual commercial outfitter’s tour page confirms year-round seven-day operation, reservation requirement and meeting address. This is not the discontinued NPS ranger-led canoe program.

events.title: Little Sugar Creek Greenway parkrun
events.dateText: Every Saturday at 9:00 AM; register before your first visit.
events.description: A free weekly 5K community run, jog or walk. Participants can also volunteer or spectate.
events.evidenceNote: Charlotte Running Company program page lists the named parkrun, Saturday 9 AM, exact address and free registration link. The parkrun origin page blocks automated requests, so use this official local running-company page.
events.imageCaption: Community running photo from Charlotte Running Company.

events.title: Yoga at the Park — Bayfront Park
events.dateText: Mondays and Thursdays, 6:00–7:00 PM; confirm current sessions.
events.description: Outdoor yoga by the bay for all levels. Bring a mat, water and a towel; the organizer describes the sessions as donation-based.
events.evidenceNote: Official page dated Apr 13, 2026 explicitly says every Monday and Thursday. It is donation-based, not free. Current session availability should be reconfirmed.
events.imageCaption: Yoga illustration used on the official program page.

events.title: Yoga in the Park — Grant Park
events.dateText: Select Saturdays at 10:00 AM; registration required.
events.address: Near Sydney Street SE and Cherokee Avenue SE, Atlanta, GA
events.description: A beginner-friendly outdoor yoga series hosted by Neutral Moon Studio. Check the official calendar for the selected Saturdays.
events.evidenceNote: Official page says select Saturdays, not every Saturday. Registration is required; specific future dates must be confirmed.

events.title: Thursday Chess at Franklin Park
events.dateText: Thursdays from 6:00 PM
events.description: Sit down for a casual game with Prospect Park Chess Club. Beginners can learn the moves at the table, and boards are provided. Drop in without signing up.
events.evidenceNote: Club meetup schedule confirms Thursdays at Franklin Park. The club FAQ confirms free admission and no registration.
events.imageCaption: Prospect Park Chess Club photograph from a previous club gathering.

events.title: Bat Haus Drink N’ Draw
events.dateText: Wednesday evenings
events.description: Sketch a live model alongside other artists in Williamsburg. Beginners are welcome. Reserve a ticket with Bat Haus before the session.
events.evidenceNote: The organizer describes a ticketed Wednesday night series with early-bird pricing.
events.imageCaption: Drawing participants at a previous Drink N’ Draw, photographed for Bat Haus.
events.priceText: Ticket required; see organizer for current price.

events.title: November Project at Bethesda Terrace
events.dateText: Wednesdays at 6:28 AM
events.description: Meet the November Project NYC group at Bethesda Fountain for a free outdoor workout. The group mixes strength exercises with running or walking and welcomes newcomers.
events.evidenceNote: This listing covers the Wednesday Central Park workout only. The organizer also runs separate monthly Friday workouts at rotating venues.
events.imageCaption: November Project NYC community photograph from the organizer.

events.title: Brooklyn Bridge Park Open Run
events.dateText: Tuesdays at 7:00 PM
events.address: South side of Fornino, Pier 6, Brooklyn Bridge Park
events.description: Walk or run a waterfront 5K with New York Road Runners. All paces are welcome. Meet the volunteers on Pier 6 at 6:45 PM to check in.
events.evidenceNote: NYRR and the host park confirm a free Tuesday 7 PM community run, starting south of Fornino on Pier 6.
events.imageCaption: Brooklyn Bridge Park Open Run participants in a group photograph from New York Road Runners.
